Kite settings

The Buy on Kite button always copies the bond's NSE symbol and opens Kite. If you also have a Kite Connect app, paste its API key and the button will open Kite with this order pre-filled in a basket. You still review and confirm every order inside Kite. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and the key is stored only in this browser.
